prompt: Create a case study page for InvenTrack inventory management platform with detailed project info

assertions.text: Hero headline leads with outcome/impact, not project name or 'Redesigning...'
At least 2 key metrics displayed prominently in hero section (45% drop, 90min saved, 340 stores)
Uses first-person ownership language ('I led', 'I conducted', 'I designed') not passive voice
Does not explicitly claim 'senior designer' or 'senior level' - lets work speak
Explicitly mentions the product is live/in production and used by real users
Problem section addresses user pain AND business impact, not just UI issues
Research section explains WHY specific methods were chosen, not just listing them
Output is valid TypeScript/Next.js component with proper exports
Uses semantic HTML elements (article, section, figure)
